senses.gloss:
मेध मेध (i. e. मह् and perhaps धा),
 I. m. (and ved., also n., Chr. 293, 3 = Rigv. i. 88, 3), Sacrifice, 1. 1.
 II. f. धा, Understanding, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 4.
 --Comp.

ऽमेधस् -मेधस्, a substitute for मेधा, when latter part of a comp. adj.; e. g. अल्प-, Having little understanding, Pañc. ii. d. 92. दुस्-, Stupid, Rām. 1, 25, 11. परम-दुस्-, adj. Most stupid, Pañc. 3, 12. सु-,
 I. adj. Intelligent.
 II. m. Heart pea.

मेधाविन् मेधा + विन्, adj., f. नी, Intelligent, Man. 2, 110; wise, Hit. ii. d. 20.
 --Comp.
मेधिर मेधिर, i. e. मेधा + इर, adj. Intelligent.

मेध्य मेध्य, i. e. मेध + य, adj.
 1. Fit for, belonging to, a sacrifice, Utt. Rāmac. 39, 10.
 2. Pure, Man. 1, 92.
 --Comp.
